categories.main_business_segments: First Industrial Realty Trust, Inc. operates as a self-administered and fully integrated real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on the ownership, management, acquisition, development, and redevelopment of industrial real estate. Its portfolio is primarily composed of bulk warehouse, regional warehouse, and light industrial properties. The company also engages in joint ventures for select development projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations revolve around the acquisition, development, and management of industrial properties, utilizing modern construction standards and sustainable building practices. Development projects often pursue LEED certification, and the company employs a decentralized property management model supported by regional teams and local property managers. Capital improvements, renovations, and tenant build-outs are integral to maintaining and enhancing property value.
categories.primary_customers_markets: First Industrial serves a diverse base of approximately 1,000 tenants across industries such as e-commerce, third-party logistics, transportation, consumer products, retail, food and beverage, building materials, health services, and government. Its properties are leased to a wide variety of businesses, with no single tenant accounting for more than 6.1% of rent revenues.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in 18 U.S. states, with a strategic focus on 15 key logistics markets, especially those with a coastal orientation. Major concentrations are in California (Northern and Southern), Pennsylvania, Texas, Illinois, Florida, New Jersey, and other major metropolitan areas. California and Pennsylvania are the largest contributors to net operating income.
categories.supply_chain_position: First Industrial operates downstream in the supply chain as an owner, developer, and lessor of industrial real estate, providing critical infrastructure for warehousing, distribution, and logistics operations. It does not engage in manufacturing or direct logistics services but enables supply chain activities through its properties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategy emphasizes maximizing shareholder returns through internal growth (rent increases, occupancy gains, cost control), external growth (development and acquisition in target markets), and portfolio enhancement (upgrading assets and disposing of non-core properties). Sustainability, tenant engagement on environmental practices, and selective joint ventures are key themes. R&D is focused on property development, sustainability initiatives, and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through lease income from industrial properties, with most leases structured as net or semi-net, allowing for the pass-through of property-related expenses to tenants. Additional revenue streams include development fees, asset management fees from joint ventures, and gains on property sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: First Industrial competes with public industrial REITs, private real estate funds, non-traded REITs, and other real estate investors and developers, some of which have greater financial resources. It positions itself as a leading pure-play industrial REIT with a focus on high-growth, supply-constrained U.S. logistics markets, leveraging its scale and operational expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, the company owned 426 industrial properties totaling approximately 65.3 million square feet, with total assets of $4.95 billion and annual revenues of $540 million. The company reported net income of $381.6 million and funds from operations (FFO) of $301.2 million for 2022, reflecting strong growth in rental rates and high occupancy (98.8%). The company continues to expand through development and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: First Industrial offers institutional-quality industrial real estate solutions in key U.S. logistics markets, emphasizing operational excellence, tenant satisfaction, and sustainable practices. Its decentralized management, focus on high-barrier-to-entry markets, and commitment to portfolio quality and environmental responsibility differentiate it from competitors and create long-term value for tenants and shareholders.
